note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. Every building, space and participant is generic and fictional; the two scenes differ only in the supplied configuration (joined / apart), shown as configured (illustrative). Nothing states who may attend, a secrecy or confidentiality rule, a vote, a hierarchy, a time span or any outcome. Long-labels-stress: capped as a QUALITY CHOICE (LAW-0223 precedent), not because the floors forced it. Rendered at 1:1 (reviewer ab9e15ad1018c7435 measurements), near-maximum texts (every field within 2 characters of its limit, four participants, two shared facts; round 2 layout with the guide's 48 px channel) fit at 1:1 at 16.6 px text with people 54.1 px (56.2 px for a slightly shorter set), above the 45 px 1:1 contrast stress floor (coordinator decision, production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md); the cap keeps the two scenes larger (people 62.8 px, text 16.6 px). Layouts tried: headers beside the stacked scenes (0.16/0.20/0.26), a right-hand text column (0.22/0.26/0.30), shared content drawn once in a 3-5 column strip, participants packed in one row, room depths 228/240/270. Every capped field stays longer than its baseline counterpart; counts stay >= baseline (4 participants vs 3, 2 shared facts vs 1).
